task_completion.description: Open the DICOM node configuration or preferences window in Weasis.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box or preference pane titled 'DICOM Nodes', 'DICOM Query/Retrieve', or similar is visible within the Weasis application.

task_completion.description: Enter the correct description for the new node.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Regional_Partner_PACS' is typed into the Description field of the node configuration.

task_completion.description: Enter the correct AE Title for the new node.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'REGIONAL_ARCHIVE' is typed into the AE Title field.

task_completion.description: Enter the correct Hostname and Port for the new node.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Hostname field shows '10.99.50.200' and the Port field shows '11112'.

task_completion.description: Save or apply the new node configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks an 'OK', 'Apply', or 'Save' button, and the new node appears in the list of configured DICOM nodes.

task_completion.description: Save a screenshot of the configuration interface to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window or terminal output confirms the creation of 'pacs_node_config.png' on the Desktop, or the agent is seen performing a 'Save As' action to that specific path.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the Weasis GUI to configure the node rather than just creating a dummy file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Weasis menus and text fields, not just a terminal command creating an image.

integrity.description: Ensure the screenshot is a genuine capture of the application and not a mock-up.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshot contains standard OS UI elements (window borders, taskbar) consistent with the rest of the trajectory.

integrity.description: Verify the agent is interacting with the real Weasis DICOM viewer interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Weasis logo, DICOM toolbars, or specific medical imaging interface elements are visible.
